records.mat_z: 高岭土瓷胎 · 釉下钴蓝
records.pz: 钴料绘于素坯、罩透明釉一次高温烧成，蓝色沉入釉下永不被磨去。开光构图把器面切分为若干装饰空间，便于批量绘制与跨文化辨识——这是它为远方陌生人准备好的视觉语言。
records.pe: Cobalt painted on the raw body, covered with clear glaze, fired once at high temperature: the blue lies beneath the glaze and can never wear off. Panelling divides the surface into legible fields — a visual language prepared for strangers far away.

records.mat_z: 瓷胎 · 釉下青花 + 釉上红金彩
records.mat_e: Porcelain, underglaze blue + overglaze red & gold
records.pz: 日本有田窑获得钴料与画样后，没有止于模仿：青花保留为骨架，红与金被叠加其上。纹样仍是中国的牡丹凤凰，色彩体系却是日本感性的热烈——继承纹样，重写审美。
records.pe: Arita potters kept the cobalt skeleton but added red and gold over the glaze. The motifs stay Chinese; the colour system turns emphatically Japanese. Inherit the pattern, rewrite the aesthetic.

records.mat_z: 锡釉陶（非瓷） · 柔和钴蓝
records.pz: 欧洲此时尚不能烧造硬质瓷，代尔夫特以锡釉陶转译青花。钴蓝因铅釉而柔和发灰，画工笔下的中国亭台从未有人亲见——这是一次带着误读的致敬，也是欧洲"中国风"（chinoiserie）的起点。
records.pe: Europe could not yet fire true porcelain, so Delft translated blue-and-white into tin-glazed earthenware. The cobalt softened to grey under lead glaze, and the pavilions were drawn by hands that had never seen China — a misreading that became chinoiserie.

records.mat_z: 碧玉细炻瓷 · 蓝即本体
records.mat_e: Jasperware · blue as the body itself
records.pz: 韦奇伍德索性取消了"画上去的蓝"：蓝成为坯体本身的颜色，白色浮雕从蓝底上浮现。青花从一个装饰系统变成一种材料观念——这次旅行抵达最远处：纹样消失了，颜色活了下来。
records.pe: Wedgwood abolished the painted blue altogether: blue became the body itself, with white reliefs rising from it. Qinghua turned from a decorative system into an idea of material. The furthest point of the journey — the pattern vanished, the colour survived.
